content:
Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.
Current time: Monday, July 6th, 1998 - 09:00 (UTC) / 1998-07-06 09:00 UTC

Based on two recent rides—3.5 hours and 140 Load total—and yesterday’s positive Form (+7), you’re currently fresh enough for one quality session plus endurance.

**Saturday — Sweet spot, ~70 min**  
Warmup → 15 min, 50–70% FTP  
Main → 3×12 min at 88–92% FTP, 5 min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown → 10 min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: ~0.82 · Load: ~75–80  
Why: Develop sustained power without excessive fatigue.

**Sunday — Endurance, 2 hours**  
Warmup → 10 min, gradually to 60% FTP  
Main → 100 min at 60–72% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown → 10 min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: 0.65–0.70 · Load: ~85–100  
Why: Build aerobic durability after Saturday’s controlled quality.

If sleep is poor or your legs feel heavy Saturday, replace the sweet-spot work with 60 minutes easy at 56–70% FTP.
